seo.title: Thank You — Employee Onboarding
seo.description: Your onboarding details have been received. A copy has been emailed to you.

blocks.title: Thank you — your details have been received
blocks.subtitle: We've successfully recorded your onboarding submission. A copy of everything you submitted has been emailed to you for your records.

blocks.title: Submission complete
blocks.body: Your onboarding form has been submitted and locked. Our HR team has been notified and will review your details. A confirmation email containing a full summary of the information you provided has been sent to the email address on your record.

items.text: Our HR team reviews your submitted personal, statutory and financial details.
Your documents and validations (PAN, Aadhaar and bank) are verified as part of the review.
Once confirmed, you'll be set up as an employee and HR will reach out with your joining details.

blocks.title: This link is now closed
blocks.body: For security, your onboarding link has been deactivated after submission. If you need to make a correction, please contact HR rather than reopening the link.

blocks.text: If you didn't receive your confirmation email or have any questions about your onboarding, please get in touch with our HR team, who will be happy to assist you.
